sensory_details_i_remember: I remember the faint scent of antiseptic wafting from the clinic, mixed with the sweet smell of nervous sweat
I noticed the soft hum of fluorescent lights above, flickering in rhythm with the anxious murmurs of my fellow students
I felt the cool, smooth surface of the bench beneath me, a stark contrast to the turmoil brewing inside
I recall the muffled sound of keyboards clacking and resumes being frantically edited, punctuated by hushed whispers of 'what if I don't get placed?'
